images.prompt: Natural architectural photograph of a small traditional timber pavilion beside a quiet narrow canal, viewed diagonally from the opposite bank. A single rectangular building with four front posts supporting a gray tiled gable roof, simple wood lattice windows, a low wooden railing and one stone step leading to the water. Camera far enough back that the COMPLETE building including both ends, all roof corners, the entire right gable and every post is inside the frame with at least 10 percent empty margin on BOTH left and right. The building occupies no more than 70 percent of image width and the canal fills the lower quarter; trees and an overcast sky around it. Straight natural architectural perspective, realistic weathered timber and stone. Portrait 4:5 at least 1024x1280 pixels, no people, signs, calligraphy, drawing, watermark or logo.

review.reason: The new natural photograph contains the complete core timber building: both roof ends and the near-right gable have visible margins, all four front support posts are visible, and roof/column/railing connections are coherent. Central doors, flanking lattice windows, stone steps and canal reflections provide clear structure. Trees and canal naturally extend outside the frame without clipping the building. No text, watermark or branding is visible.

images.actual_source_analysis: The vertical photograph shows one complete timber building on the opposite stone bank of a canal. Its gray tiled pitched roof has visible left and right end corners, and the near right triangular gable remains entirely inside the image. Four front wooden posts support the porch roof. Low wooden railings occupy the left and right porch sections, leaving a central entrance. The rear facade contains a central pair of paneled wooden doors with lattice upper sections and rectangular lattice window groups on either side. Pale stone foundations and a short central set of steps descend from the porch toward the canal bank. The right side wall has dark wooden boards below pale plaster within timber framing. Water fills the lower portion and reflects the building and columns. A large leafy tree stands to the left, additional green foliage surrounds the building, and an overcast gray sky occupies the upper center. The building silhouette is fully visible; vegetation and water continue naturally beyond the frame. No people, signs or lettering are visible.
